title: CausalEvo: Causal Skill Self-Evolution for Health LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.21016v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents for health can accumulate reusable textual skills from task feedback, such as calculation criteria, measurement time points, and formula units. Deciding which skills to retain is consequential: useful rules improve later answers, while faulty generalizations propagate errors. We propose CausalEvo, a method for causal skill self-evolution that estimates the relative effects of deliberately changed skill sets while holding the model weights, feedback cases, and rule count fixed. At each evolution step, a frozen LLM proposes candidate rules, which are pooled with the incumbent skills so that the current skill set remains a feasible choice. Paired skill replacements against shared background rules are scored on the same feedback cases; least squares converts the score differences into relative skill values, and the top-ranked rules are retained, favoring incumbents on ties. translated_title: CausalEvo：面向健康LLM智能体的因果技能自进化
translated_abstract: 面向健康领域的大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以从任务反馈中积累可复用的文本技能，例如计算标准、测量时间点和公式单位。决定保留哪些技能至关重要：有用的规则能够改善后续回答，而错误的泛化则会传播错误。我们提出了CausalEvo，一种因果技能自进化方法，它在保持模型权重、反馈案例和规则数量固定不变的情况下，估计经过刻意变更的技能集的相对效果。在每个进化步骤中，一个冻结的LLM提出候选规则，这些候选规则与现有技能汇集在一起，使当前技能集始终保持为可行选项。针对共享背景规则的成对技能替换在相同的反馈案例上进行评分；最小二乘法将评分差异转换为相对技能价值，排名靠前的规则被保留，平局时优先保留现有技能。一个决策损失界将因果……
tldr: 提出CausalEvo方法，通过在固定模型权重、反馈案例和规则数量的条件下估计技能集变更的相对因果效应，实现健康LLM智能体的技能自进化筛选，保留有效规则并防止错误泛化的传播。
en_tdlr: CausalEvo enables causal skill self-evolution for health LLM agents by estimating the relative causal effects of deliberately changed skill sets while holding model weights, feedback cases, and rule count fixed, thereby retaining useful rules and preventing faulty generalizations from propagating errors.
